notes.title: Demo is live!!
notes.content:
Hello! 
Thanks for checking out my game, it's early and rough but I hope you had a good time!

[h2]Dev plans;
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Boss editor:
   Boss appearance editor! 
   Better boss editor UI over all.
   More varied attacks, if you have ideas please post screenshots lol!
[*]Story campaign maker, basically just bosses linked together with some words in between. 
[*]A fun intro and a cool ending, with deepest lore.
[*]Upgrade system, I'm thinking a gem slot system. Like gems on the wand to do more damage or homing bullets etc.
[*]Also thinking about special abilities, maybe tie that to an item you can hold in your offhand, a big missile or a short shield effect etc.
Gems and items would drop on boss kills.
[/list]


Anyway this is what I'm planning, if you have thoughts feel free to drop them below or make a discussions thread. I'd really appreciate it.

xoxo tjerny
